hints.title: Monotonic Feasibility
hints.text: If a max identical character length m is achievable with operations, all values greater than m are also achievable.

hints.title: Alternating Base Case
hints.text: For m = 1, compare s to alternating 0101 and 1010 patterns and sum minimum differences.

hints.title: Run-Length Division
hints.text: For m > 1, each contiguous run of length L requires floor(L / (m + 1)) flips.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary search on max identical character run length m with linear checks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all flip subsets produces 2^n exponential state space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space beyond string scanning pointers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies binary search on monotonic target length and isolates m = 1 alternating edge case.
